FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No.RD 622 KAMGRARA 2017 Dated
10.08.2017 regarding altering the limits of Musukinakallhalli village of Hadagali
Taluk and Vijayanagara District and constituting a new revenue village called
Kenchammanhalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. Part
no 4a page no 8071 to 8084 dated 14.09.2017inviting objections or suggestions from
all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its

publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Vijaynagara
district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:20.10.2023And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village MUSUKINAKALLAHALLI, Hadagali Taluk in VIJAYANAGARA District
to form a new revenue village called as KENCHAMANAHALLI of Huvinahadagali
Taluku and VIJAYANAGARA District along with the survey numbers included in
column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No.RD 109 PFH 2022 Dated:27-06-2022
regarding altering the limits of Mattur village of Maski Taluk and Raichur
District and constituting a new revenue village called Satyasevalal Nagar was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD109 2022 Dated: 27-

06-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected
thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette
addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Raichur district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:29-06-2022 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Mattur to form a new revenue village called as Satyasevalal Nagar of Maski
taluk Raichur District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

Raichur District and constituting a new revenue village called SHRI RAMANA
BAYI NAGAR was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD
333 PFH 2022 dated:05-11-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication

here by makes the following notification, namely:-

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose
s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of HIREBANNIMATTI Village of
HVUINAHADAGALI taluk VIJAYANAGARA District and to constitute a new
revenue villages called as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and NANDIGAVI new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner,
VIJAYANAGARA District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said

village of HIREBANNIMATTI, HUVINAHADAGALI TALUK in
VIJAYANAGARA District to form a new revenue village called as NANDIGAVI of
Huvinahadagali Taluku and VIJAYANAGARA district District along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 330 PFH 2022
dated:05-11-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Raichuru district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 07-11-2022 And whereas, No objections and suggestions have been received;

Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

village Hadagali to form a new revenue village called as VIJAYA NAGAR of
MASKI taluk Raichur District along with the survey numbers included in
column (4) thereof.

here by makes the following notification, namely:-

specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Sultanpur of Maski taluk Raichur District to form a new revenue village
called as Krishna nagara of Maski taluk Raichur District along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No.RD 397 PFH 2022 Dated:
04-01-2023 regarding altering the limits of Gogi (K) village of Shahapur Taluk and
Yadgir District and constituting a new revenue village called Rama Nayakana Halli,
Gangoo Nayak Halli & Revunayakana Halli was published as required by section 6
of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the
Karnataka Gazette No. 54 Part IV-A Dated:09.01.2023 inviting objections or
suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from
the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner Yadgir district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:30-10-2023 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 22 KAMGRARA 2021 Dated
01-02-2022 regarding altering the limits of Shreenivas sardagi village of Kalburagi
taluk and Kalaburagi District and constituting a new revenue village called
constituting a new revenue village called Krishna Nayak Tanda, Hundu Nayak
Tanda and Dharu Nayak Tanda was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette No. RD 380 PFH 2022dated 20-12-2022 inviting objections or suggestions
from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its
publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Kalaburagi
district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public Dated:
21-12-2022 whereas, No objections and suggestions were received;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of
Karnataka here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column (3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of Dharu Nayak Tanda village of
Kalaburagi Taluk of Kalaburagi District convert the same to form hamlet/extension
within the boundary of Shreenivas sardagi Revenue village and same will herein
after be named as Dharu Nayak Tanda of Shreenivas sardagi village in Kalaburagi
Taluk of Kalaburagi District.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 373 PFH 2022 Dated: 12.6.2022
regarding altering the limits of Kollur village of Chitthapur Taluk and Kalaburagi
District and constituting a new revenue village called Choukandi Tanda was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 373 PFH
2022Dated:12.6.2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to
be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Kalaburagi district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:
12.6.2022 And whereas, No objections and suggestions were received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Kollur of Chittapura taluk in Kalaburagi District to form a new revenue
village called as Chowkandi Tanda of Chittapura taluk Kalaburagi District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 261 PFH 2022 Dated 11/10/2022
regarding altering the limits of Kudamud village of Kamalapur Taluk and
Kalaburagi District and constituting a new revenue village called Nagalingeshwara
nagar was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act,
1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD209
KAMGRARA 2016 dated 15-01-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Kalaburagi district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 26/01/2023 And whereas, No objections and suggestions were received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said

village Kudamud of Kamalapur taluk in Kalaburagi District to form a new
revenue village called as Nagalingeshwara nagar of Kamalapur taluk Kalaburagi
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

and constituting a new revenue village called Jagadamba Nagar And Ramsamudra
Tanda (Sub Village) was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land

Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. 57
Part IV-A Dated:09.01.2023 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons
likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the
Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Yadgir district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public Dated:
27.10.2023 And whereas, No objections and suggestions were received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Ashnal of Yadgir taluka in Yadgir District to form a new revenue village
called as Jagadamba Nagar And Ramsamudra Tanda (Sub Village) of Yadgir
taluk Yadgir District along with the survey numbers included in column (4)
thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 53 GLH 2023,
Dated:20/02/2023 regarding extend the original gramatana extent of Kolavanahalli
in Nandi Hobli of Chikkaballapura Taluk, Chikkaballapura District was published
as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act
No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 53 GLH 2023 Dated: 06/03/2023

inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

And Whereas, the said Gazette was made available to the public on
Date:07/03/2023 and Whereas, no objections and suggestions are received.

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
hereby makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE

Land bearing survey numbers in column (2) and extent specified below in
column(3) of the table shall be declared as habitation area of Kolavanahalli village of
Chikkaballpura taluk of Chikkaballpura district and convert the same to form
habitation extension within the boundary of Kolavanahalli Revenue village and
same will be named as part of original gramatana extent of Kolavanahalli village
Chikkaballpura Taluk, Chikkaballpura District.

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 22 KAMGRARA 2021 Dated

was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 234 GLH 2022
dated 20-12-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Kalaburagi district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 21-12-2022 And whereas, No objections and suggestions were received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE

table shall be declared as habitation area of called Kasunayak Tanda village of
Kalburagi Taluk of Kalburagi District convert the same to form hamlet/extension

within the boundary of Kerur Revenue village and same will herein after be named as
called Kasunayak Tanda of Kerur village in Kalburagi Taluk of Kalburagi
District.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose
s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Itaga (k) Village of Kalabuagi taluk
Kalaburagi District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Itaga (k)
Tanda as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and
new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Kalaburagi
District.

village called as Itaga (k) tanda of Kalaburagi taluk Kalaburagi District along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12
of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. LD 320 LSi 2021 dated 30-11-2022 inviting
objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within
thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the
Deputy Commissioner Kalaburagi district.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 30-11-2022 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of Ashok Nagar tanda village of Kalagi
Taluk of Kalaburgi District convert the same to form hamlet/extension within the
boundary of Kadcharla Revenue village and same will herein after be named as
called Ashok Nagar of Korawar village in Kalagi Taluk of Kalaburgi District.
